blockchain.title: Get Blockchain Details
blockchain.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific blockchain

blockchain.title: Get Network Stats
blockchain.description: Get comprehensive network statistics and metrics
blockchain.prompt: Show me an overview of the {network} network

blockchain.title: Get Blockchain Analytics
blockchain.description: Get detailed analytics for a blockchain including transactions and active accounts
blockchain.prompt: Show me analytics for blockchain {brid} from {fromTimestamp}

blockchain.title: Get Monthly Active Users
blockchain.description: Get monthly active accounts for a specific blockchain
blockchain.prompt: How many monthly active users does blockchain {brid} have?

blockchain.title: Find DApp BRID
blockchain.description: Find the blockchain RID (BRID) for a specific dApp by name
blockchain.prompt: What is the BRID of {dappName} on {network}?

transactions.title: List Recent Transactions
transactions.description: Gets recent transactions with optional filtering

transactions.title: Filter Transactions By Time
transactions.description: Get transactions within a specific time range
transactions.prompt: Show me transactions from {network} between {startTime} and {endTime}

transactions.title: Get Account Transactions
transactions.description: Get transactions involving a specific account
transactions.prompt: Show me transactions for account {accountId} on {network}

assets.title: Asset Distribution
assets.description: Shows distribution information for a specific asset
assets.prompt: Show me the distribution of asset {assetId}

assets.title: Search Assets
assets.description: Search for assets by name or symbol

assets.title: Asset Top Holders
assets.description: Get the top holders of a specific asset
assets.prompt: Who are the top holders of asset {assetId}?

assets.title: Asset Blockchain Distribution
assets.description: See which blockchains contain a specific asset

assets.title: Find Top CHR Holders
assets.description: Find who holds the most CHR tokens
assets.prompt: Who holds the most CHR tokens on {network}?

assets.title: Find Top Token Holders
assets.description: Find who holds the most of a specific token
assets.prompt: Who holds the most of token {assetId} on {network}?

analytics.title: Network Overview
analytics.description: Get comprehensive network statistics and metrics
analytics.prompt: Show me an overview of the {network} network

analytics.title: Account Statistics
analytics.description: Get account-related statistics for a network
analytics.prompt: How many accounts are there on {network}?

analytics.title: Transfer Statistics
analytics.description: Get transfer-related statistics for a network
analytics.prompt: How many transfers have occurred on {network}?

monitoring.title: Node Availability
monitoring.prompt: Show me downtime periods for node {pubkey} on {network} since {startTime}

accounts.title: Account Activity
accounts.description: Get information about account activity across blockchains
accounts.prompt: Show me which blockchains account {accountId} has been active on in {network}

accounts.title: Signer Activity
accounts.description: Get information about signer activity across blockchains
accounts.prompt: Show me which blockchains signer {signer} has been active on in {network}

chr.title: CHR Token Flow
chr.description: Get CHR token deposit and withdrawal information

chr.title: Total Rewards
chr.description: Get total rewards paid on the network
chr.prompt: How much has been paid in rewards on {network}?

dapp_analytics.title: DApp Active Users
dapp_analytics.description: Get the number of monthly active users for a specific dApp
dapp_analytics.prompt: How many active users does {dappName} have on {network}?

dapp_analytics.title: DApp Transaction Volume
dapp_analytics.description: Get transaction volume for a specific dApp
dapp_analytics.prompt: What is the transaction volume for {dappName} on {network}?

dapp_analytics.description: Track user growth over time for a specific dApp

discovery.title: Find DApp by Name
discovery.description: Search for a dApp by its name and get its details
discovery.prompt: Find me details about the dApp called {dappName} on {network}

discovery.title: Top Active DApps
discovery.description: Get a list of most active dApps by transaction volume
discovery.prompt: What are the most active dApps on {network}?

discovery.title: DApp Asset Usage
discovery.description: Find which assets are most used in a specific dApp
discovery.prompt: Which assets are most used in {dappName} on {network}?

operations.title: List Operations
operations.description: Get a list of all available operations across blockchains

documentation.title: List Documentation
documentation.description: Get a list of all available documentation files and directories

documentation.title: Read Documentation
documentation.description: Read the content of a specific documentation file
documentation.prompt: Show me the content of documentation file {path}
